items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcXhiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b2eaf79fa44c4c6c1a974cf9aa8e36e9c23675ab/WCC%20alt%20+%20newcomer%20logo.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHNYIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--36307c5514bc8fbbcd5f7d0435fb449ed0337df6/tpc-banner-text.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png) # This competition is in celebration of WCA Newcomer Month! This competition is catered to all speedcubing newcomers and we welcome you to register for this competition! - Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to partner with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive) to bring another competition to Northern California with a **focus on the live-stream and first-time competitor experience!** - This competition will be testing the new revolutionary score-taking technology, **TimeBase!** We will be using traditional scorecards but will be offering a brand-new, paperless scoretaking experience for all registered competitors! - This competition will be running a **Stationary Solve Station** set-up! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. # Competitors can bring 1 guest for free to the competition! If they would like to bring a 2nd or more guests, we are charging $5 per extra guest via paypal at the front desk. Spectators not associated with the competition may still pay the $5 fee to attend and watch the competition up close and personal!

items.name: Big Cubes Athens 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ZpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2ad4e4f29cfeee447dd4662438ee1c08da476ee/image.png) Mετά τη συναρπαστική πορεία του 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' η δράση συνεχίζεται με τον επόμενο διαγωνισμό της σειράς, αυτή τη φορά με έμφαση στα μεγάλα παζλ! Καλωσορίζουμε τους παίκτες στο δεύτερο μέρος αυτής της συναρπαστικής περιπέτειας, όπου τα παζλ υψηλής δυσκολίας θα κλέψουν την παράσταση. Από τon 4x4x4, μέχρι τoν 7x7x7. Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι σχεδιασμένος να δοκιμάσει τις δεξιότητες και την υπομονή των πιο έμπειρων cubers. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να δείτε και να συμμετάσχετε σε αυτό το θέαμα δεξιοτεχνίας και αντοχής, όπου το μέγεθος και η πολυπλοκότητα πραγματικά μετράνε. Ετοιμάστε τους κύβους σας για μια ακόμα πρόκληση στον κόσμο του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) After the exciting run of 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' the action continues with the next competition in the series, this time with an emphasis on big puzzles! We welcome players to the second part of this thrilling adventure, where high-difficulty puzzles will steal the show. From the impressive 4x4x4s to the complex 7x7x7s and other equally challenging sizes, this competition is designed to test the skills and patience of the most experienced cubers. Don't miss the opportunity to witness and participate in this spectacle of dexterity and endurance, where size and complexity truly matter. Prepare your cubes for another challenge in the world of cubing! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthIdahoNewcomers2024#40699-competitor-responsibilities) tab. For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)! This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will reserve 40% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 40% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 60% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 40% of new competitors register before 60% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: ## 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다. ## 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 갱신되니, 참가 신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다. 이 대회는 참관객 비용과 참관객 인원 제한이 존재합니다. 참가 및 동반자 비용 납부는 [대회 참가 신청 및 비용 납부](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaSpring2024#40418-registration-and-payment-details) 탭을 눌러 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다. 요청 시, 모든 참가자가 스태프로 활동해 주셔야 합니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. ___ ## Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, as registration is processed on a first-come first-served basis, you might be put on the waitlist. ## You should be able to see your name on either the competitor list or waitlist within 3 days of paying the registration fee. This competition has a spectator fee and a limit on the number of spectators. Please see [Registration and Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaSpring2024#40418-registration-and-payment-details) tab for information regarding fees for competitors and spectators. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
